zh-CN.blog.title: 从选型到部署，帮你走好每一步
zh-CN.blog.description: 从选型到部署，帮你快速熟悉云服务，走好每一步上云之路。
zh-CN.blog.posts.enterpriseCloud.title: 企业上云：从第一步到规模化
zh-CN.blog.posts.enterpriseCloud.excerpt: 选型、迁移、治理——一套可落地的路径。
zh-CN.blog.posts.enterpriseCloud.body: 企业上云不是把服务器搬到线上就结束，而是一次关于效率与治理的升级。从轻量起步、按业务分期迁移，到统一权限、成本与合规治理，每一步都需要路径清晰的规划。我们用十余年运营经验，帮你把云用得明白、用得稳。
zh-CN.blog.posts.reliability.title: 稳定，是一种工程决策
zh-CN.blog.posts.reliability.excerpt: 高可用不是魔法，是多区域、多副本与自动故障转移的组合。
zh-CN.blog.posts.reliability.body: 高可用不是一句承诺，而是一系列工程决策的组合：多可用区部署、数据多副本、自动故障检测与切换、可观测性闭环。你看到的是「从没出过事」，背后是我们对每一个环节的反复演练。
zh-CN.blog.posts.security.title: 从网络到数据，安全的上云姿势
zh-CN.blog.posts.security.excerpt: 网络隔离、主机加固、数据加密与合规审计，一样都不能少。
zh-CN.blog.posts.security.body: 安全上云不是买一个防火墙就结束。入口侧要网络隔离与 WAF 防护，主机侧要补丁与基线加固，数据侧要加密与备份，事后还要有审计与处置预案。从攻防演练到等保测评，我们把安全当作一项长期工程持续投入。
zh-CN.blog.posts.cost.title: 云成本治理：把钱花在刀刃上
zh-CN.blog.posts.cost.excerpt: 预算、标签、弹性伸缩与账单分析，形成成本闭环。
zh-CN.blog.posts.cost.body: 上云之后账单为什么还是涨？多半是资源闲置与规格浪费。通过标签管理、弹性伸缩、规格匹配与账单分析四件套，你可以把每一分钱花在真正需要的算力上。我们提供成本体检服务，帮你找出 30% 以上的隐藏浪费。

en-US.blog.description: From selection to deployment, get comfortable with cloud services and every step of the journey.
en-US.blog.posts.enterpriseCloud.title: Enterprise cloud: from first step to scale
en-US.blog.posts.enterpriseCloud.excerpt: Selection, migration, governance — a path you can actually execute.
en-US.blog.posts.enterpriseCloud.body: Moving to the cloud is not finished once servers are online; it is an upgrade in efficiency and governance. From a lightweight start and phased migration by business line to unified permissions, cost and compliance governance, every step needs a clear plan. With over a decade of operating experience, we help you use the cloud clearly and steadily.
en-US.blog.posts.reliability.title: Stability is an engineering decision
en-US.blog.posts.reliability.excerpt: High availability is no magic — it is multi-region, multi-replica and automated failover combined.
en-US.blog.posts.reliability.body: High availability is not a promise; it is a combination of engineering decisions: multi-AZ deployment, data replicas, automated failure detection and failover, and a closed observability loop. What you see is "nothing ever went wrong"; behind it is our repeated rehearsal of every link in the chain.
en-US.blog.posts.security.title: From network to data: doing cloud security right
en-US.blog.posts.security.excerpt: Network isolation, host hardening, data encryption and compliance auditing — all are required.
en-US.blog.posts.security.body: Secure cloud adoption does not end with buying a firewall. The ingress needs network isolation and WAF protection, hosts need patching and baseline hardening, data needs encryption and backups, and afterwards there must be auditing and response plans. From red-team exercises to compliance assessments, we treat security as a long-term engineering investment.
en-US.blog.posts.cost.title: Cloud cost governance: spend where it counts
en-US.blog.posts.cost.excerpt: Budgets, tags, autoscaling and billing analysis form a cost loop.
en-US.blog.posts.cost.body: Why does the bill keep rising after moving to the cloud? Usually idle resources and oversized specs. With tag management, autoscaling, right-sizing and billing analysis, you can spend every cent on the compute you actually need. We offer cost health checks that surface more than 30% in hidden waste.
